title: The common-stage projection proper equation on finite models
statement:
Fix finite-field datum $D$, coefficient datum $C$, and $H:\mathrm{SixFunctorCommonStages}(D,C)$ [def-sf-operation-stages]. Write $S=H.\mathrm{commonStage}$, $T_X=H.\mathrm{commonStageTensor}(X)$, $\pi_{f,c}(K,L)$ for the specified compact-support projection [def-sf-constructible-projection-mates], and $\iota_{E,X}$ for the common-stage inclusion [def-weil-algebraically-closed-coefficients]. Fix one finite coefficient field $E$ and suppose its rational stage satisfies CompactSupportProjectionCoherence on every second input [def-sf-projection-comparison-equations]. Let $f:X\to Y$ be proper between SixFunctorSpace objects, and $c$ any compactification of $f$. For $K_E\in\mathrm{Stage}_E(X)$ and $L_E\in\mathrm{Stage}_E(Y)$, set $K=\iota_{E,X}K_E$ and $L=\iota_{E,Y}L_E$. Write $j$ for the hom component of $S.\mathrm{properIdentification}_{f,c}$ and $\pi_f^{\mathrm{proper}}$ for the specified proper-counit projection [def-sf-constructible-projection-mates]. Then
$$T_Y(j_K,1_L);\pi_f^{\mathrm{proper}}(K,L)=\pi_{f,c}(K,L);j_{T_X(K,S.\mathrm{pull}_fL)}.$$
Semicolon denotes composition in displayed order. This asserts only the proper equation on the included models, with no invertibility, composition or pentagon conclusion.

proof.text: Obtain one tensor endpoint comparison for coefficient inclusion and the two individual-map comparison squares from lem-sf-common-projection-proper-tensor-compatibility. Its hypotheses contain no projection coherence equations. The existential witness is used only in this proposition proof. The compact-support square is valid for every f and is specialized here to proper f; the proper square is an additional conjunct for the same t.

Apply the coefficient comparison compactification square and properIdentity square to show inclusion(j_c) followed by the direct-image comparison equals the support comparison followed by the common-stage j_c. Tensor naturality gives the corresponding source square; naturality of j_c at the inner tensor comparison gives the target square. These are the private proper_identification, source_proper and target_proper calculations.

Precompose the desired equation with the invertible compact-support source comparison. Rewrite its left side using source_proper and the proper projection square. Use inclusion.map_comp and the finite-stage proper equation supplied by hH. Rewrite the result with target_proper and the compact-support projection square, and cancel the source comparison. This is the generic private proper_transfer proof applied to K0 and L0.

lean.statement:
theorem commonProjectionProper_onStage
    {D : FiniteFieldDatum.{u}} {C : D.CoefficientDatum}
    (H : SixFunctorCommonStages D C)
    (E₀ : Padic.FiniteCoefficientFields C.l C.Qbar)
    (hH : CompactSupportProjectionCoherence (H.coefficientStages E₀).rational
      (H.coefficientStages E₀).rationalTensor (H.coefficientStages E₀).rationalExchange
      (fun _ _ ↦ True))
    {X Y : SixFunctorSpace D} (f : X ⟶ Y) [IsProper f.hom.left]
    (c : Compactification f.hom.left)
    (K₀ : GeneralAlgebraicallyClosedCoefficients.Stage C.l C.Qbar X.obj.left E₀)
    (L₀ : GeneralAlgebraicallyClosedCoefficients.Stage C.l C.Qbar Y.obj.left E₀) :
    let K := (GeneralAlgebraicallyClosedCoefficients.inclusion
      (l := C.l) (Ω := C.Qbar) (Y := X.obj.left) E₀).obj K₀;
    let L := (GeneralAlgebraicallyClosedCoefficients.inclusion
      (l := C.l) (Ω := C.Qbar) (Y := Y.obj.left) E₀).obj L₀;
      ((H.commonStageTensor Y).map ((H.commonStage.properIdentification f c).hom.app K)).app L ≫
          compactSupportProperProjection H.commonStageExchange f K L =
        compactSupportProjectionComponent H.commonStageExchange f c K L ≫
          (H.commonStage.properIdentification f c).hom.app
            (((H.commonStageTensor X).obj K).obj ((H.commonStage.pull f).obj L))
